subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the dependency/auth-stack path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The active PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while the remaining auth-stack path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term fix shape alone.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer fix lands and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path is either fixed or live-proven no longer reproducible.

options.title: Split The Auth-Stack Path
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused follow-up and let this issue close only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Accept Sanitizer-Only Closure
options.body: A provider owner can close this after the sanitizer lands, but that risks losing the latest-release service-account ADC reproduction unless it is preserved elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer fix lands and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios path is either fixed or live-proven no longer reproducible.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and close/split triage for the canonical issue.
